direct_query.sql:
SELECT 
TOP (1000001) [t0].[fiscal_year] AS [c3],[t1].[org_group] AS [c7],
COUNT_BIG(*)
 AS [a0],SUM([t3].[amount])
 AS [a1]
FROM 
(
((
select [$Table].[date_key] as [date_key],
    [$Table].[month_key] as [month_key],
    [$Table].[org_key] as [org_key],
    [$Table].[account_key] as [account_key],
    [$Table].[amount] as [amount],
    [$Table].[load_date] as [load_date]
from [dw].[spike_v_fact] as [$Table]
) AS [t3]

 LEFT OUTER JOIN 

(
select [$Table].[month_key] as [month_key],
    [$Table].[month_start] as [month_start],
    [$Table].[year] as [year],
    [$Table].[month_no] as [month_no],
    [$Table].[month_name] as [month_name],
    [$Table].[fiscal_year] as [fiscal_year]
from [dw].[spike_v_dim_month] as [$Table]
) AS [t0] on 
(
[t3].[month_key] = [t0].[month_key]
)
)


 LEFT OUTER JOIN 

(
select [$Table].[org_key] as [org_key],
    [$Table].[org_code] as [org_code],
    [$Table].[org_name] as [org_name],
    [$Table].[org_group] as [org_group],
    [$Table].[paybill_cost] as [paybill_cost]
from [dw].[spike_v_dim_org] as [$Table]
) AS [t1] on 
(
[t3].[org_key] = [t1].[org_key]
)
)

GROUP BY [t0].[fiscal_year],[t1].[org_group]
